summary: CCSP and CCSPv2 default to METRICS_UTILITY_DEDUPLICATOR=ccsp (hostname only, preferring ansible_host over host_name); ccsp-experimental also merges hosts sharing ansible_product_serial and ansible_machine_id.
questions: How do I deduplicate hosts in a CCSPv2 report?
Does metrics-utility use ansible_host or host_name?

answer_card.title: Deduplication in CCSP reports
answer_card.answer_md:
- Default `METRICS_UTILITY_DEDUPLICATOR=ccsp`: hostname only; `ansible_host` (from `main_host.variables`) wins over `host_name`
- `METRICS_UTILITY_DEDUPLICATOR=ccsp-experimental`: also merges entries whose `ansible_product_serial` **and** `ansible_machine_id` are both present and duplicated
